questions.question: Express 0.4 overline{32} in the form of p/q, where p and q are integers, and q ≠ 0.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

To convert a **Mixed Recurring Decimal** like 0.43232... to a fraction:

**Numerator** = (Complete number without bar) − (Non-repeating part) = 432 − 4 = 428

**Denominator** = Put 9 for each repeating digit (3, 2) and 0 for each non-repeating digit (4) = 990

Fraction = 428/990 = 214/495

**∴ The correct answer is (214)/(495).**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Decimal value x = 0.4323232...

**Formula Used:** Algebraic manipulation by shifting decimals to eliminate repeating parts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/813a6d441cf06357981035314ceb2c7624310557d431be08bfe9d3ff056e5307.png] 

⇒ Let x = 0.4323232... — (Eq 1)

⇒ Multiplying (Eq 1) by 10: 10x = 4.323232... — (Eq 2)

⇒ Multiplying (Eq 1) by 1000: 1000x = 432.323232... — (Eq 3)

⇒ Subtracting (Eq 2) from (Eq 3):

⇒ 1000x − 10x = 432.3232... − 4.3232...

⇒ 990x = 428

⇒ x = 428/990

⇒ Simplifying by dividing both by 2: x = 214/495

Therefore, the fraction in **p/q form** is 214/495, which corresponds to **Option (3)**.

**∴ The correct answer is (214)/(495).**

**__Additional Information__**

Pure Recurring Decimal

A decimal in which all the figures after the decimal point are repeated. Example: 0.333... = 1/3.

Mixed Recurring Decimal

A decimal in which some digits are not repeated and some are repeated. Example: 0.1222... = (12−1)/90 = 11/90.

Denominator Rule

The number of 9s is equal to the number of repeating digits, and the number of 0s is equal to the number of non-repeating digits after the decimal point.</p

questions.question: If A, B and C are non-empty sets, then (A - B) ⋃ (B - A) equals
questions.solution:
__Concept:__

__
 
• A ⋃ B denotes the elements which are in set A or set B.
 
• A ∩ B denotes the elements which are in both set A and set B.
 
• A-B denotes the elements which are only in set A and not in B.
 
• B-A denotes the elements which are only in set B and not in set A.

**Calculation:__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d3d8eedc6d55379106d716bb0702c019f2f2edb45f510d4ed3ec0db856e5ca9.png] 

As it can be seen from the Venn diagram the purple area is (B - A) and the orange area is (A - B).

The green area is (A ∩ B) and all three of those areas together are (A ⋃ B).

It can be seen that (A - B) ⋃ (B - A) is the orange and the purple areas together.

This can also be found in the difference between (A ⋃ B) and (A ∩ B). 

**Hence, (A - B) ⋃ (B - A) = (A ⋃ B) - (A ∩ B)**

questions.question:
What is the value of (2x + 3y), if mean of the following distribution is 54?

 
 

 
 
Class

 
 
 
0 - 20

 
 
 
20 - 40

 
 
 
40 - 60

 
 
 
60 - 80

 
 
 
80 - 100

 
 
 
Total

 
 
 

 
 
Frequency

 
 
 
7

 
 
 
11

 
 
 
x

 
 
 
9

 
 
 
y

 
 
 
50
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total **Frequency** N = 50 ⇒ 7 + 11 + x + 9 + y = 50 ⇒ x + y = 23.

Using **Assumed Mean** (A) = 50: Deviation Sum = 50 × (Mean − A) = 50 × 4 = 200.

Calculation: 7(−40) + 11(−20) + x(0) + 9(20) + y(40) = 200 ⇒ −280 − 220 + 180 + 40y = 200.

−320 + 40y = 200 ⇒ 40y = 520 ⇒ y = 13 and x = 23 − 13 = 10.

Value of 2x + 3y = 2(10) + 3(13) = 20 + 39 = 59.

**∴ The correct answer is 59.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Mean** = 54, **Total Frequency** (N) = 50.

**Formula Used:** Mean (χ̄) = (∑fᵢxᵢ) ÷ ∑fᵢ, where xᵢ is the **Class Mark**.

**Step 1:** Find the relationship between x and y from total frequency.

⇒ 7 + 11 + x + 9 + y = 50

⇒ 27 + x + y = 50

⇒ x + y = 23 — (Equation 1)

**Step 2:** Calculate ∑fᵢxᵢ using class marks (10, 30, 50, 70, 90).

⇒ ∑fᵢxᵢ = (7 × 10) + (11 × 30) + (x × 50) + (9 × 70) + (y × 90)

⇒ ∑fᵢxᵢ = 70 + 330 + 50x + 630 + 90y = 1030 + 50x + 90y

**Step 3:** Substitute in the Mean formula.

⇒ 54 = (1030 + 50x + 90y) ÷ 50

⇒ 2700 = 1030 + 50x + 90y

⇒ 50x + 90y = 1670

⇒ 5x + 9y = 167 — (Equation 2)

**Step 4:** Solve Equation 1 and Equation 2.

⇒ Multiplying Eq 1 by 5: 5x + 5y = 115

⇒ Subtracting from Eq 2: (5x + 9y) − (5x + 5y) = 167 − 115

⇒ 4y = 52 ⇒ y = 13

⇒ x = 23 − 13 = 10

**Step 5:** Calculate the final expression.

⇒ 2x + 3y = 2(10) + 3(13) = 20 + 39 = 59

**∴ The correct answer is 59.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean for Grouped Data

The mean is calculated as ∑fᵢxᵢ / N, where fᵢ is the frequency and xᵢ is the mid-point of the class interval.

Class Mark Calculation

Class Mark (xᵢ) = (Upper Class Limit + Lower Class Limit) ÷ 2. It represents the central value of the interval.

Assumed Mean Method

Used to simplify calculations: Mean = A + (∑fᵢdᵢ / N), where dᵢ = xᵢ − A and A is the assumed mean.

questions.question: If the difference between the interior and exterior angles of a regular polygon is 144°, then what is the number of sides of the polygon ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Difference between the interior and exterior angles of a regular polygon = 144º

**Concept Used:**

For a regular polygon with n sides:

 
• Interior angle = (n-2) × 180º / n
 
• Exterior angle = 360º / n

 

**Calculation:**

144 = [(n-2) × 180 / n] - (360 / n)

⇒ 144 = (180n - 360 - 360) / n

⇒ 144 = (180n - 720) / n

⇒ 144n = 180n - 720

⇒ 180n - 144n = 720

⇒ 36n = 720

⇒ n = 720 / 36

⇒ n = 20

**Hence, the number of sides of the polygon is 20.**

questions.question:
Consider the following statements in respect of two non-empty sets A and B :

1. A ∪ B = A ∩ B if A = B

2. A Δ B = ϕ if A = B

Which of the above statements is/are correct ?
questions.solution:
__**Concept:**__

1). A ∆ B is the symmetric difference that represents the objects that belong to A or B but not to their intersection.

__
 
• A Δ B = (A ∪ B) - (A ∩ B)

2). A ⊆ B subset A is a subset of B. set A is included in set B.

3). A ⋃ B, ⋃ is a union, that represents the objects that belong to set A or set B

4). A ⋂ B, ⋂ is an intersection, that represents the objects that belong to set A and set B

5). x ∈ A means x is an element of A, i.e. belongs to set membership

**Calculation:**__

Given that, A and B are two non-empty sets.

**Statement I: **A ∪ B = A ∩ B if A = B

Let x ∈ A ⇒ x ∈ A ⋃ B, [Because A ⊆ A ⋃ B]

⇒ x ∈ A ⋂ B, [As A ⋃ B = A ⋂ B]

⇒ x ∈ A and x ∈ B ⇒ x ∈ A,

⇒ B ⊆ A

Now, A ⊆ B, B ⊆ A ⇒ A = B

Statement I is correct.

Statement II: A Δ B = φ if A = B

⇒ A Δ B = φ

We know that, A Δ B = (A ∪ B) - (A ∩ B)

⇒ (A ∪ B) - (A ∩ B) = ϕ 

⇒ (A ∪ B) = (A ∩ B)

⇒ A = B

Statement II is correct.

**∴ Statement I and II both are correct.**

questions.question: The median AD of a triangle ABC is produced and a perpendicular CF is dropped on it. BE is perpendicular to AD. If BC = 34 cm and DF = 8 cm, what is the length (in cm) of BE?
questions.solution:

DF = 8 cm

In a triangle, median bisects the side.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3c8f68f63aec87fbd171462117639400d1ce8d38b9e007e22d0f4a71da5d4f5.png] 

Given BC = 34 cm

In triangle BED and CDF

BD = CD (because AD is median)

∠E = ∠F

∠BDE = ∠CDF (vertically opposite angles)

Therefore Triangle BED and CDF are congruent

Therefore, BE = CF

In triangle BED:

(BD)² = (BE)² + (ED)²

⇒ (17)² = (BE)² + (8)2

⇒ 289 = 64 + (BE)2

⇒ (BE)2 = 289 - 64

⇒ BE = sqrt(225)

⇒ BE = 15 cm

**Thus, the length of BE is 15 cm.**

questions.question: There are 100 students in a class. In an examination, 50 of them failed in Mathematics, 45 failed in Physics, 40 failed in Biology and 32 failed in exactly two of three subject. Only one student passed in all the subjects. Then the number of students failing in all the three subjects is

options.text: Cannot be determined from the given information

questions.solution:
**__Concept:__**

__
 
• The number of elements in a set A is denoted by n(A).
 
• If there are three sets A, B and C then** n(A) + n(B) + n(C) = n(A ⋃ B ⋃ C) + n(A ∩ B) + n(B ∩ C) + n(C ∩ A) - n(A ∩ B ∩ C)**

**Calculation:__**

Given, there are 100 students in a class. In an examination, 50 of them failed in Mathematics, 45 of them failed in Physics, 40 failed in Biology and 32 two failed in two of the three subjects. Only one student has passed all three subjects.

Let us assume that the set of students who failed in Mathematics, Physics, and Biology are A, B, and C respectively.

Since the total number of students is 100 and only one has passed all the subjects, then 99 of them have failed at least one of the exams.

Hence, n(A ⋃ B ⋃ C) = 99.

Now, n(A) = 50, n(B) = 4 and n(C) = 40

The number of students who have failed all three subjects is n(A ∩ B ∩ C).

A number of students who have failed Mathematics and Physics but passed in Biology is n(A ∩ B) - n(A ∩ B ∩ C). 

Similarly, number of students who have failed Mathematics and Biology but passed in Physics is n(A ∩ C) - n(A ∩ B ∩ C) and the number of students who have failed Biology and Physics but passed in Mathematics is n(B ∩ C) - n(A ∩ B ∩ C).

Now, 32 of them failed strictly two of the three subjects. 

Hence, n(A ∩ B) - n(A ∩ B ∩ C) + n(A ∩ C) - n(A ∩ B ∩ C) + n(B ∩ C) - n(A ∩ B ∩ C) 

⇒ n(A ∩ B) + n(A ∩ C) + n(B ∩ C) - 3n( A ∩ B ∩ C) = 32

⇒ n(A ∩ B) + n(A ∩ C) + n(B ∩ C) = 32 + 3n(A ∩ B ∩ C)

According to the formula mentioned above, 

**n(A) + n(B) + n(C) = n(A ⋃ B ⋃ C) + n(A ∩ B) + n(B ∩ C) + n(C ∩ A) - n(A ∩ B ∩ C)**

⇒ 50 + 45 + 40 = 99 + 32 + 3n(A ∩ B ∩ C) - n(A ∩ B ∩ C)

⇒ 2n(A ∩ B ∩ C) =135 -131 = 4

⇒ n(A ∩ B ∩ C) = 2.
